title: Modular inverse
description: Implement mod_inverse(a, m). Return the integer x with 0 <= x < m such that (a * x) % m == 1, using the extended Euclidean algorithm or equivalent. a may be negative or larger than m. Raise ValueError if m < 2 or if a and m are not coprime (no inverse exists).
invariants: a may be negative or >= m.
Raise ValueError when gcd(a, m) != 1 or m < 2.
